description: This file defines the PersonalizeRuntimeClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the Amazon Personalize Runtime service. It includes method annotations for operations like getActionRecommendations, getPersonalizedRanking, and getRecommendations, both synchronous and asynchronous.

classes.name: PersonalizeRuntimeClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the Amazon Personalize Runtime service. Inherits from AwsClient and provides methods to perform service-specific operations.

methods.name: getActionRecommendations
methods.description: Retrieves action recommendations for a user based on their interactions.

methods.name: getPersonalizedRanking
methods.description: Provides a personalized ranking of items for a user.

methods.name: getRecommendations
methods.description: Gets recommendations for a user based on their interaction history.
